title: Fail agent-driven iOS builds quickly when signing is locked
summary: Marcos Placona traces a silent 30-minute iOS signing hang to a locked keychain and adds a preflight with time limits around security commands. An iOS team can fail signed builds with an actionable error before archiving; his follow-up clarifies that FileVault still requires login after reboot, so this is not a demonstrated unattended recovery solution.
takeaway: Bound signing preflight calls, stop on a locked keychain, and test reboot recovery separately; never treat a successful logged-in build as proof of unattended operation.
